Wispr Flow is the voice dictation and Notetaker tool we use for expert interviews on Breakdown. Try it with a 90-day Pro trial.
How to redeem:
Open Settings, then Plans and Billing.
Notes:
The code only works on the desktop app. It does not work on the browser.
One code per account, tied to the email you sign in with.
Works on individual accounts only (not team, enterprise, or student plans).
